limits: Profile percentages are self-sample time divided by the selected guest-worker span, including waits and attachment margins. They are not whole-process utilization or throughput measurements.

No owned build, profiler or correctness replay ran during the timing campaign. No observations were discarded.
The direct-memory implementation already existed; this change selects it in normal browser runs and aligns the profiler and replay defaults.
Snakes pairs have opposing signs (+7.05%, -10.80%); mean -2.46% does not establish either a benefit or zero regression.
Correctness replay and live checks ran after the timing panel, sometimes concurrently; their elapsed times are not performance evidence.
Existing compiler/fault suites and exact-binary two-game replay evidence are reused; only the default-selection Snakes replay and live launch checks are newly run for this adoption.
